parameters.content:
## Landing.jobs Scraper

Remote backend roles from the Landing.jobs public REST API (`GET /api/v1/jobs`, JSON, no auth).

**Schedule:** Every 15 minutes
**Source:** `landingjobs`

1. Get criteria from Job Hunter API
2. Fetch all open jobs (one page)
3. Keep jobs whose tags match a tracked category
4. Normalize & send to /jobs/ingest
